Figure 2:Kierston as the initialization pipeline leaves it. Brown
squares are individual buildings of every class;
colored circles are points of interest by class; larger squares are schools
and colleges; diamonds are workplaces. Roads are the routable topology the
pathfinder is built from.

Figure 5:Structures and indicative sector coverage in Kierston. Gray
markers are structures read from the FCC registration data; blue markers are
modeled rooftops, monopoles and small cells, which cluster in the built-up
core where short structures are excluded by the registration threshold. Wedges show
each sector’s planning range on its azimuth. The low bands (n71, B12, B13,
B14 and B5) are omitted for readability; their footprints cover the whole
extent.
